plugins.name: hopper
plugins.description: Realtime inference API for open-source models in your agent: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Gemma 4 31B, plus Qwen 3 TTS and Nemotron ASR. Test the models on your own prompts, add a key to your code, speak text and transcribe audio.

plugins.name: hopper-announce
plugins.description: Claude Code says out loud when a long task finishes: one short sentence in a Hopper voice. Speaks only for tasks of 20 seconds or more; adjustable or off with one sentence.
